gloss: main unlucky year; principal calamity year

definitions.gloss: main unlucky year; principal calamity year
definitions.explanation: The central and most critical year in the yakudoshi cycle, when one is believed to be most susceptible to misfortune. The ages differ for men and women.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{本厄|ほんやく}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{気|き}をつけよう→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: This year is my main unlucky year, so I should be careful.

examples.japanese: {本厄|ほんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えて→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧、⟦{厄払|やくばら}い→厄払い：22342_yakubarai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧きた。
examples.english: Having reached my main unlucky year, I went to have a purification ritual performed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大厄|たいやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数|かぞ}え{年|どし}→数え年：22294_kazoedoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧42⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧で、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本厄|ほんやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧べきだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The great calamity year for men is age 42 by traditional counting, and it is said that one should avoid making major decisions during this main unlucky year.

notes:
Part of the ⟦{厄年|やくどし}→厄年：05809_yakudoshi⟧ (unlucky year) system in Japanese folk belief. The ⟦{厄年|やくどし}→厄年：05809_yakudoshi⟧ cycle consists of three years: ⟦{前厄|まえやく}→前厄：25748_maeyaku⟧ (the year before), {本厄|ほんやく} (the main year), and ⟦{後厄|あとやく}→後厄：25749_atoyaku⟧ (the year after). {本厄|ほんやく} is the peak year when misfortune is considered most likely.

The main ⟦{厄年|やくどし}→厄年：05809_yakudoshi⟧ ages (by traditional counting, ⟦{数|かぞ}え{年|どし}→数え年：22294_kazoedoshi⟧) are:
- Men: 25, 42 ({大厄|たいやく}), 61
- Women: 19, 33 ({大厄|たいやく}), 37, 61

Many Japanese visit shrines for ⟦{厄払|やくばら}い→厄払い：22342_yakubarai⟧ (purification rites) during their {本厄|ほんやく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本厄|ほんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach one's main unlucky year
- {本厄|ほんやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{厄払|やくばら}い→厄払い：22342_yakubarai⟧: purification for the main unlucky year
- {本厄|ほんやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧: the year of one's main yakudoshi

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前厄|まえやく}→前厄：25748_maeyaku⟧: the year before the main unlucky year — considered a warning period
- ⟦{後厄|あとやく}→後厄：25749_atoyaku⟧: the year after the main unlucky year — misfortune is fading but caution remains
- {大厄|たいやく}: the greatest unlucky year — the most feared year (42 for men, 33 for women)
- ⟦{厄年|やくどし}→厄年：05809_yakudoshi⟧: unlucky year — the general term for the entire yakudoshi system
